lead.hed: Heritage: 25 years after 9/11, the Navy is still the long-reach weapon against al Qaeda
lead.insight: Heritage Foundation, Thursday: Brent Sadler marks the anniversary and argues U.S. sea power — submarines and carriers — opened the war after Sept. 11 and remains the reach that land campaigns cannot match. Commentary, not a new statute.
lead.image_credit: U.S. Navy photo by Mass Communication Specialist 2nd Class Tajh Payne · DVIDS 9615140 · Public domain · Sailors on the flight deck of USS Gerald R. Ford (CVN 78) in the Mediterranean, April 12, 2026.

political.hed: Heritage: after 9/11, reform immigration and end perpetual wars
political.insight: Heritage Foundation, Thursday: a second anniversary essay argues the country still needs immigration enforcement and an end to open-ended wars. Opinion essay, not a floor vote.

political.hed: Defense News: Iran strike in Jordan damaged U.S. A-10 and F-15s
political.insight: Defense News, Thursday: a U.S. official told Reuters Iranian strikes this week hit Muwaffaq Salti Air Base in Jordan, damaging one A-10 and eight F-15s. Official attribution; damage counts come from that report.

political.hed: SOUTHCOM: three killed in a Caribbean strike on an alleged drug boat
political.insight: USNI News, Thursday: Joint Task Force Western Hemisphere struck a go-fast in the Caribbean late Wednesday, killing three, SOUTHCOM said. First such strike in September, the service report said.

tech.hed: Defense News: India sources nearly all of $11.6 billion in new hardware at home
tech.insight: Defense News, Friday: New Delhi said nearly all of $11.6 billion in recently approved military equipment will come from domestic manufacturers, part of a push to cut import dependence.

tech.hed: Defense News: Iran likely to reverse-engineer a captured U.S. underwater drone
tech.insight: Defense News, Thursday: CENTCOM said an older Anduril Dive-LD went dead in the water and was recovered by Iran. Analysts expect hardware copying; software has built-in defenses.

culture.hed: WORLD: The Uprising wants Braveheart and cannot hold the tone
culture.insight: WORLD News Group, Thursday: the R-rated historical epic starring Andrew Garfield as “the Ploughman” in a Peasants’ Revolt story has sincere faith and grit, then turns comic-book and morally muddled. Review, not a box-office print.

culture.hed: Law & Liberty: a Nobel economist forgets how markets work
culture.insight: Law & Liberty, Thursday: John O. McGinnis reviews Daron Acemoglu’s new book and says the solutions drop public-choice limits while calling for a pro-worker AI agency. Book review, not a vote.
